positions.title: Application Development Manager
positions.description:
Smart Package Smart Facility (SPSF)
- Implemented RFID package scanning and misload detection application with GCP, Mobile(MAUI/Xamarin), Web(Angular), Messaging(MQTT, AMQP) layers with 30+ direct reports
- Configured Honeywell 8690i and Zebra RFD40 (handheld + mounted) devices to read the package efficiently by tweaking the scanning algorithm
- Leveraged AppCenter to resolve ~98% of mobile crashing issues
- Managed distributed architecture of 1000+ individual sites
- Introduced Azure DevOps pipelines to build and deploy the projects which cut manual deployment efforts by 99%
- Resolved ~90% of social engineering attacks in first 2 months for UPS exposed 3rd party 
- Configured Akamai gateway for 3rd party APIs 
- Led the effort for migrating from legacy UDP messages to REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer lll
positions.description:
- Implemented and managed multiple Java micro services for Millennium EHR for maintaining provider, hospital and organizational data
- Setup Elasticsearch using Lucene to index and search the pharmacy data
- Setup docker container based testing for running isolated functional testing
- Implemented REST services based on FHIR and E-Prescription 2017 spec requirements
-Enhanced the automated regression testing for parallel usage and re-using data to cut down on time from 2.5 hours to 30 mins
- Migrated Cerner proprietary database layer to standard JDBC
- Implemented Oracle database change notification to get the updates from database in pub sub style
